slalom.scope: Prepared masked linear and one-use trusted-client Freivalds verification. No enclave or attestation reproduction.
slalom.result: New Qwen comparison blocked by memory admission: 10.04 GiB estimated versus 7.74 GiB safe headroom at 32+1 bounds. No score from this attempt. Historical cold CPU results use a different cohort.

smoothquant.scope: Public per-channel equalization, fixed alpha=3/4, bounded scales and trusted-client activation scaling.
smoothquant.result: Separate Phi diagnostic: 2/2 top-token agreement and 9.59 worst logit error, versus plain W8A8's 1/2 and 29.90. Qwen decoder comparison remains unmeasured.

curl.scope: Fig. 4 party-local shared lookup plus public Haar compression. Inputs are already truncated; no protected truncation, Biorthogonal protocol or decoder integration.
curl.result: 512-row Q16 SiLU lookup reconstructs every encoded value. Four Haar levels reduce dealer-share payload from 4,100 to 260 bytes, but add up to 0.12888 absolute error. Peer frames remain 136 bytes per lookup. No Qwen score.

compact.scope: Public calibration, private interval selection and one-use Chebyshev evaluation with bounded compiler binding.
compact.result: Checked encoded profile parity; polynomial half-gate bodies exceed the direct Q7 lookup for the tested profiles. No tensor transport or Qwen decoder score.

logrow.scope: One-use masked-index lookup and bounded in-process tensor override, with the earlier two-row setup.
logrow.result: Tiny decoder experiments pay more online CPU and offline issuance than clear SiLU. No protected real-checkpoint SDK composition.

half-gates.scope: Native one-use Boolean half-gates, free XOR and bounded private selection/arithmetic circuits.
half-gates.result: Native circuit correctness and one-use tests; no independent cryptographic review or full-decoder benchmark.

garbling-gadgets.scope: Bounded CRT arithmetic garbling and Q7 multiplication adaptation.
garbling-gadgets.result: Primitive parity and material measurements only; no complete protected Qwen decoder score.

dash.scope: Bounded arithmetic-label and projection-gate adaptation; the paper's complete prepared convolutional network is not implemented.
dash.result: Bounded integer oracle and one-use tests. No whole-model cost comparison.

maverick.scope: Public coded-matvec verification and RAA numeric algebra, plus Appendix E public-subspace leakage regression. No LPN input privacy or full-width admission.
maverick.result: Bounded code-distance and algebra checks. Exponential reference code length prevents decoder admission; no Qwen performance score.

carnival.scope: Attack against deficient public mask spans, following the later Maverick analysis. Carnival inference is not implemented.
carnival.result: Constructs bounded mod-2 leakage witnesses over u16/u24/u32 masks. An attack control has no inference-performance score.

mpcache.scope: Model-neutral KV eviction transformation and state contracts; protected selection and transformed runtime remain incomplete.
mpcache.result: Semantic transformation tests only. No measured transformed decoder.
